scope: Code-only JS geometry projection. No app, emulator, screenshots, Skia recording or native rendering was used.

methodology.comparison: Median of three independent reference runs and three candidate runs, alternating order; processes ran sequentially without concurrent tests or exports.
methodology.geometry: The production motion/overview/regional/detail tiers, using the same canvas-corner viewAngleFor clipping rule as MiniGlobe.
methodology.sink: Counts path commands and accumulates coordinate checksums. Does not emulate native Skia costs.
methodology.correctness: Differential path-command tests against d3-geo at 1e-6 pixel tolerance, including holes, polar/antimeridian views, long hidden runs, and detailed coastlines.

decision.kept: Precompute spherical caps for blocks of 64 consecutive vertices in runs of at least 128 vertices. Clip only hidden-block endpoints, preserving entry/exit state and all visible path commands.
decision.simplification: Reuse the existing cap calculation and clipper; no new library, spatial index, geometry simplification, frame throttling or extra per-frame allocations.
decision.whole_planet: Bypass block tests for hemispheric views: little benefit there, so avoid their overhead.
decision.tradeoff: Median land-layer construction increased by approximately 0.02–1.73 ms on this host. Regional/detail geometry passes save approximately 1.46/3.00 ms each; construction is paid once per layer.
decision.limits: These are V8 microbenchmarks, not Hermes, device frame rates, startup latency or battery measurements. Existing exact-settled-frame caching also affects the end-to-end gain.

regression_baselines: Added only complete globe.production geometry passes (25% p50 drift) and layer construction (50%) to perf/baselines.json. Individual layer timings remain diagnostic: two substeps varied more than 50% across candidate runs. Historical entries/metadata remain unchanged; this report records the environment for the new entries.
